title: treatment-catalog.v1
description: The call treatments a system under test offers, by shape id: how a caller requests each one, the callee-side legs it opens, and the endings that count as success. Read by the runner, the SIPp injection-file renderer, loadgen and the classifier. ADR-0049.

name.description: The catalog name, unique on the search path; a run profile names catalogs by it.

placeholders.description: The placeholders `${name}` the request values of this catalog use, each with what the consumer fills in. A consumer refuses a catalog naming a placeholder it does not fill.

shape.description: The shape id: unique across every catalog on the search path. It is the record's `shape`, the `shape` label of every series, and the id a loadgen product shape registers under.

request.description: What the caller's initial INVITE carries to request the treatment. Values may hold `${name}` placeholders.

ruri_user.description: The Request-URI and To user part.

headers.description: Header fields added to the INVITE, in order.

legs.description: The callee-side legs the treatment opens toward the generator, in the order they are opened, and how a generator playing them tells them apart.

expected.description: The caller endings that count as success; any other ending is an impact.

load_safe.description: The shape keeps its expected endings under sustained load (no timer of the treatment races the generator's own timing). A run profile refuses a stream on a shape that is not.

role.description: The leg's name in the record's `legs`.

ruri_prefixes.description: Request-URI user-part prefixes that select this leg on the generator's callee socket; the longest match wins.

expected.description: The leg endings that count as success. A primary route the treatment fails over from expects `rejected` with its code.

code.description: The final's status code; required for `rejected`.

early_media.description: Whether early media (an 18x with a session description) must precede the final (`true`) or must not (`false`). Absent, either.
